The Story
When Seattle financier Mark Hensley dies in what authorities call a tragic road accident, whispers spread across the city that the crash wasn’t real. It was a projection from another dimension — a staged echo masking his abduction by something far beyond human reality.
Mark had been taken. Not by men. But by something far older and far darker than anything humanity has ever imagined.
Days later, impossible evidence begins to surface across Seattle, pulling detectives into a maze of unexplained phenomena, encrypted symbols, and supernatural events that defy every known law of science.
Unknown to his family, Mark had spent years chasing a terrifying truth hidden in his bloodline: the El Noche Code — an ancient, encrypted intelligence woven into his DNA and bound to a forbidden artifact calledEl Legado La Noche, a mystic diary said to open gateways to lost dominions and underworld realms billions of light‑years away, and granted access to a lost portal known as the Veil of Asterion — a dimension of immense power, wealth, and forbidden knowledge.”
Mark’s investigation led him to a single origin: Madrid, 1752. There he discovered that his great‑grandfather, Rodney Hensley, once possessed the diary. Rodney’s blood had been altered; the Code integrated into his line, and the diary vanished into shadow. For generations the Hensley’s carried the legacy unknowingly — until Mark, drawn by an inexplicable pull toward Spain, found the diary and began decoding its symbols.
The codes were not inert. They vibrated as if alive. When Mark read the first lines aloud, the relic inside him mistook the reading for an activation. Signals erupted across distant dominions. Portals stirred. Hidden kingdoms answered.
What Mark did not understand was that the El Noche Code is both an intelligence and artifact: a living encryption that exists as an encoded pattern and physical relic at once. Deciphering the diary’s lines triggered a chain reaction — awakening ancient forces, secret occult networks, and a centuries‑old operative who had hunted the diary across realms.
For four centuries the relic had been lost, and ruthless dynasties and galactic empires had waged wars to possess it. Now, with electromagnetic pulses detected, the balance of hidden worlds shatters. Dark kingdoms, supernatural dynasties, and sovereigns of the underworld converge on Earth to extract the Code at any cost.
Among them is Queen Velinda of the Codex Dominion — a conqueror who once annihilated entire civilizations in her obsession to claim the diary and the Elnoche Code . Empires have collapsed trying to control the relic; entire realms have burned in pursuit of its power. Hidden within the El Noche relic lies in something far greater than anyone imagined: the living architecture of creation itself.
Caught at the center of the approaching war is Mark’s son, Eli Hensley — the last living carrier of the El Noche Code and the key to the survival of every known world. As dark forces close in from beyond space and reality, humanity must confront a devastating truth: Earth was never alone, and it was never safe.
The Conflict
The moment the Code awakens, it is no longer hidden. It is hunted relentlessly. Across the realms. Across time. and Across existence itself. And every faction believes the same thing: Whoever controls the El Noche Code controls reality.
